reuse.why: Reuses link.assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and generalises the Akahu downloader for Fintegra, but the link handler itself copies the per-provider link body instead of extracting a shared one.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade-or-create account, payee insert, initial sync, sync-event), adding a sixth copy of the same block.

placement.why: Handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and types in types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Only server-side Fintegra support and its tests; the Akahu downloader rename is a necessary part of sharing the transaction download.

maintainability.why: The download path is nicely shared, but any change to account linking must now be repeated in one more copy.
